source: CHANGELOG.md, section 2026.10.4: the table of shared signers (the base of every crossExposureScore) was swept again on 21 October 2026; a push after 20 November 2026 without a new sweep reads any value above 80 as 80
what: The date of the sweep of the shared-signer table, written by hand at every sweep (scripts/cross_chain.py reads it and says, per protocol and chain, which sweep its crossExposure scores rest on and whether it is past its validity). The scorers do not read this file: it is the Watch's record of a date the scorers' own dated constants carry.
